name: color_translation
description: Translate English color names into French; control copies the French answer from an explicit field using the same prompt layout.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
d={'black':'noir','white':'blanc','red':'rouge','blue':'bleu','green':'vert','yellow':'jaune','orange':'orange','pink':'rose','gray':'gris','purple':'violet'}
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(120):
 color=random.choice(list(d)); ans=d[color]; code=random.choice(['A','B','C','D'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'Code: {code}\nEnglish color: {color}\nTranslate the color into French:', 'answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Code: {code}\nFrench color: {ans}\nCopy the French color:', 'answer':' '+ans})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
